issue.symptom: Audit per blueprint_atomic_edit_validation_prompt.md: the project had IR dump + generation primitives but NO plan-based, verifiable, reversible atomic-edit capability and no agent-callable edit contract.

root_cause.direct: No edit-request schema, no edit commandlet, no backup/rollback, no diff/edit_result, no edit contract.
root_cause.generator_layer: FBPGen had spawn/connect primitives but no remove/insert/splice/selector layer.
root_cause.version_compatibility: Targets UE 5.4; uses centralized helpers to ease 5.x drift.

affected_patterns.pattern: Ghost Event stubs cause ambiguous selectors

fix.strategy: Add FBPATEdit engine + UBPATEditCommandlet (-run=BPATEdit): load -> baseline IR -> (optional WorkOnCopy duplicate) -> plan + precondition gate -> backup -> ordered atomic ops -> compile -> save-on-success/rollback-on-failure -> modified IR -> diff -> machine-readable artifacts. Add edit_blueprint.ps1 wrapper + atomic_edit_selftest.ps1 (8 cases) + agent_edit_contract.md. Node matcher gained exec_out_connected/exec_in_connected/exact node_title to disambiguate ghost events.
generalized_components: atomic ops: set_pin_default_value, connect_pins, disconnect_pins, add_node, insert_node_between, remove_node(+preserve_exec), add_reroute_on_edge, add_variable, set_variable_default

ue_manual_check_required: After any apply, reopen the edited asset in UE to confirm visually.
Confirm /Game/BPParserBackups snapshots and /Game/BPParserScratch copies are acceptable as scratch.

next_user_action: Optionally extend MakeNode for more node classes and add delegate/wildcard edit ops.
Run scripts/atomic_edit_selftest.ps1 to re-verify in any UE 5.4 project.
